svg.title: The longest day
svg.desc: A globe of glowing dots turns through the 24 hours of the June solstice. The sun lights the left side, the terminator glows orange, and fifty of the largest cities switch on as night reaches them, while a clock counts the hours in UTC.

g.text: One turn of the Earth in 1,393 dots of land.
Fifty cities switch on as the sun sets on them.
